item.title: NNPC Chief Bayo Ojulari Visits Dangote Refinery
item.description: NNPC GCEO Bayo Ojulari is on a courtesy visit to the Dangote Petroleum Refinery, with senior management in tow.

item.title: Ojulari: ‘Audacious’ Dangote Refinery Front Line Of World-Class Tech, Nothing Beats Seeing It Physically
item.description: NNPC chief, Bayo Ojulari, hails Dangote Refinery as “the front line of world-class technology” while undertaking a tour alongside senior management.

item.title: Police Arrest 13 Over Ondo APC Congress Killings
item.description: Ondo police detain 13 suspects following deadly Idanre ward congress violence that left two dead and others injured.

item.title: Concern As Multiple Micronutrient Supplements Run Short In Nasarawa
item.description: Health officials confirm shortage of Multiple Micronutrient Supplements despite ₦125m government funding to combat anaemia in Nasarawa.

item.title: Tinubu Felicitates Air Force Chief, Sunday Aneke, At 54
item.description: President Tinubu praises Air Marshal Aneke’s patriotism and professionalism as he marks his 54th birthday.

item.title: Low Turnout as NNPP, PDP, ADC Boycott Kano Bye-Elections
item.description: Major opposition parties boycott Kano bye-elections, citing inadequate notice and lack of confidence in electoral process credibility.

item.title: Ramadan Major Factor In Low Kano Bye-Election Turnout, Says INEC
item.description: INEC attributes low voter turnout in Kano bye-elections to Ramadan timing and limited contest competitiveness.

item.title: Dangote Says NNPC’s Visit To Refinery ‘Best Day Ever’, Promises Shares For Sale To Nigerians Within Five Months
item.description: During "best day ever" at his refinery, Dangote says Nigerians can buy shares within five months, with dividends payable in naira, dollars.

item.title: Peaceful Polls, Low Turnout Mark Rivers Bye-Elections
item.description: Rivers records peaceful bye-elections in Ahoada East and Khana amid low turnout and minimal security presence.

item.title: Amupitan Lauds Peaceful Conduct, Early Deployment For Abuja Council Polls; Wike Bemoans Low Turnout
item.description: INEC lauds peaceful conduct and early deployment as voter apathy dominates Abuja Area Council elections.
